owner_review.coverage: Complete GWH1–GWH15: original right and left connection signs; both endpoint Ward constraints and complete nonnegative row defect; actual SG averaging and exact finite kinetic root; full covariant graph with changing gauge rank and row minimum; equivariance of physical exact-current projection; complete physical gauge norm correction; all current, scalar, complementary, spatial and mixed-variance receivers.
owner_review.strengthening: The actual kinetic ceiling is 3sqrt(5/7)/(2kappa), with a stronger individual face floor and full current bounds. The exact full gauge graph gives both the entire minimum row energy and the physical vertical norm loss, retaining all zero modes.
owner_review.correction: Horizontality is proved for the invariant exact-current columns by gauge equivariance and the invariant scalar inverse. Exactness alone would not establish horizontality. A row minimizer is not asserted to assemble into a new Hessian.
owner_review.limitations: The full gauge norm cross covariance and spectral allocation remain next calculations. This increment does not establish the smooth interacting continuum state or no-gap endpoint.
